scope_lanes.Repo Governance: Only100 reserved originals MT-34218..MT-34317 plus this report

STU-WEB-001.method: Expose web-mode text editing, parsed-tree projection, preview, intelligence, CSS, breakpoints, templates and site/publish descriptors as one document capability set; delegate design conversion through its published port.
STU-WEB-001.planned_proof_cases: Open a web-mode document offline, edit source and inspect matching tree/preview revision; site/publish descriptors remain readable without connecting a server.

STU-WEB-002.method: Classify server models for editing and round-trip only; never attach execution or database-connect behavior to language detection.
STU-WEB-002.planned_proof_cases: Load dynamic source with unreachable remote and database targets; author, validate and prepare publish bytes without server execution or connection.

STU-WEB-003.method: Store ordered source bytes as authority and attach revision-bound element projection; translate a structural edit into an explicit text patch and preserve unmodelled spans.
STU-WEB-003.planned_proof_cases: Apply a tree edit to parsed markup containing an unknown construct, save and reparse; unchanged unknown bytes survive and stale projection rejects without mutation.

STU-WEB-004.method: Capture newline, indent, quoting and tag-case from source; save only explicit text changes and reserve reformatting for web.format_source.
STU-WEB-004.planned_proof_cases: Save mixed-case tags, quoted attributes and opaque constructs without formatting; compare unchanged spans byte-for-byte then run explicit format separately.

STU-WEB-006.method: Separate local authoring/intelligence/preview inputs from publish target capability; omit account/network dependency from portable engine startup.
STU-WEB-006.planned_proof_cases: Disconnect network and supply no account; edit, validate, preview and inspect locally; publishing without a declared target reports its missing target.

STU-WEB-007.method: Emit typed source/artifact references and authority-record payloads for document, site, receipt, snippet, template and lint data; consume persistence ports rather than introducing a database.
STU-WEB-007.planned_proof_cases: Round-trip each payload through the published storage port and content-addressed byte reference; host SurrealDB schema/ledger persistence proof remains on exact existing host map.

STU-WEB-008.method: Emit navigation target descriptors for web document, site and published diff for consumption by existing navigation layers.
STU-WEB-008.planned_proof_cases: Request each target and inspect its stable document/site/revision reference; unresolved target yields typed failure without installing another router.

STU-WEB-009.method: Treat458 web-tagged registry entries as sizing metadata; derive functional coverage from normative WEB clauses rather than a numeric target.
STU-WEB-009.planned_proof_cases: Inspect domain descriptors against current normative obligations; missing behavior fails even when registry count equals458, and count drift reports provenance.

STU-WEB-010.method: Keep baseline source features non-generative; expose any later model assistance only via the existing model-lane adapter contract.
STU-WEB-010.planned_proof_cases: Use code intelligence and snippets without inference; reject an attempt to execute an undeclared model capability rather than inventing vendor generation.

STU-WEB-011.method: Decode document type fields separately, keep Windows/Mac extension arrays ordered, and choose first extension for new-document naming.
STU-WEB-011.planned_proof_cases: Create types with multiple extensions and nullable server/starter refs; verify default extension order, MIME and BOM survive serialization.

STU-WEB-012.method: Decode internal_kind through the six closed members; DYNAMIC carries a server_model_id, TEMPLATE consumes region rules.
STU-WEB-012.planned_proof_cases: Round-trip each legal kind and reject an unknown kind without changing existing source; dynamic/template routes retain their declared metadata.

STU-WEB-013.method: Load all39 rows from the complete clause table with exact type_id, ordered platform extensions, MIME, BOM, DTD and server model; retain per-document BOM override independently.
STU-WEB-013.planned_proof_cases: Reconcile all39 records and four default-BOM rows against table; create/save each family and override BOM, checking bytes and extension selection without executing server code.

STU-WEB-014.method: Validate dtd_context against seven tokens and use it to select applicable tag libraries and validator rules.
STU-WEB-014.planned_proof_cases: Select html/xml/svg/wml/xslt/jsp_tag_library/none; reject unknown context, then inspect tag/rule resolution for each legal context.

STU-WEB-015.method: Offer ten doctype IDs with literal declaration payloads and choose html_5 for a new HTML document; preserve chosen literal bytes on conversion.
STU-WEB-015.planned_proof_cases: Create default HTML and convert each supported declaration, compare literal emitted bytes; missing literal source is a recorded gap, never reconstructed from a name.

STU-WEB-016.method: Resolve referenced non-source MIME by exact thirteen-extension table; unlisted extension uses application/octet-stream and receipt warning.
STU-WEB-016.planned_proof_cases: Resolve aliases jpg/jpeg and tif/tiff plus all listed entries; unknown extension produces octet-stream and correction warning without changing asset bytes.

STU-WEB-017.method: Load library identity/name/type applicability/prefix/count/chooser fields and filter libraries by current document type before resolving a tag.
STU-WEB-017.planned_proof_cases: Resolve same tag against eligible and ineligible libraries; unmatched type returns no definition and diagnostic, preserving original text.

STU-WEB-018.method: Load ten library declarations and all reachable definitions; compare470 declared definitions with466 indexed references and report the delta rather than dropping leaves.
STU-WEB-018.planned_proof_cases: Enumerate each library applicability and prefix, reconcile reachable nonindexed definitions, inspect startup diagnostic and verify definitions remain usable.

STU-WEB-019.method: Decode tag_name/library_id/end-tag mode/tag_type/formatting/inspector/attributes as typed fields; distinguish XML self-close from HTML end-tag rules.
STU-WEB-019.planned_proof_cases: Round-trip yes/no/xml end modes and empty/nonempty/null tag kinds; invalid token reports load error with source bytes retained.

STU-WEB-020.method: Apply declared per-tag newline/indent/content/case rules only in explicit formatting; protect pre/script/style/textarea contents and namespaced attribute case.
STU-WEB-020.planned_proof_cases: Format protected content and namespaced attributes, compare their bytes; exercise table domains while retaining the ten-versus-eleven-key spec ambiguity as a dispatch blocker.

STU-WEB-021.method: Decode attribute name/type/case flag and ordered value/caption entries; attach allowed_values only to enumerated type.
STU-WEB-021.planned_proof_cases: Round-trip ordered enum captions and nonenum attributes; malformed enum records report source location without repairing operator text.

STU-WEB-022.method: Normalize value_type names to lower case through the twenty-member set, bind shared Controls affordances, and resolve intrinsic dimensions through granted CKC data.
STU-WEB-022.planned_proof_cases: Exercise all20 types; verify width/height src/data reads use resolved intrinsic dimensions and unknown types or unavailable CKC metadata produce typed gaps.

STU-WEB-023.method: Preserve allowed_values declaration order in the picker; validate membership as a warning carrying attribute/value/allowed set, never rewrite source.
STU-WEB-023.planned_proof_cases: Choose preferred-first value and enter an out-of-set value; verify warning fields and byte-preserved text, including after save/reload.

STU-WEB-024.method: Merge named cross-tag group attributes with per-tag attributes; on collision keep the tag-owned definition and emit load diagnostic.
STU-WEB-024.planned_proof_cases: Load three-group vocabulary with collisions and noncollisions; confirm merged attributes, precedence and diagnostic source identities.

STU-WEB-025.method: Match tags with HTML case folding and XML-family exact case; apply attribute case_sensitive overridden by preserveattrcase.
STU-WEB-025.planned_proof_cases: Resolve equivalent mixed-case HTML and distinct XML tags; format SVG/namespaced attributes and verify preserved case.

STU-WEB-026.method: Resolve declared inspector via contextual binding; undeclared inspector falls back to shared generic attribute-table descriptor.
STU-WEB-026.planned_proof_cases: Select tags with and without inspector declarations; inspect correct binding or generic fallback and typed setters without an empty panel.

STU-WEB-027.method: Accept operator/plugin library descriptors through existing consent-granted registration port; merge them into shared tag resolution/intelligence without editing shipped library bytes.
STU-WEB-027.planned_proof_cases: Register granted extension library and exercise hint/color/validation; revoked or missing capability rejects registration and retains shipped registry.

STU-WEB-028.method: Build web.format_source diff from tag formatting rules and explicit indent/wrap options; dry-run changes no source, commit uses one receipt/undo entry.
STU-WEB-028.planned_proof_cases: Dry-run and apply format to document and selection, then repeat to prove byte idempotence; undo restores original and protected spans remain intact.

STU-WEB-029.method: Resolve cursor language from exact embedded-block boundaries before applying/removing comment syntax; emit command text patches.
STU-WEB-029.planned_proof_cases: Apply and remove comment inside script nested in HTML and in markup; compare language-specific bytes and undo, with ambiguous boundary reported.

STU-WEB-030.method: Expose web evidence descriptors to shared Studio-wide contextual-panel owner; retain all-domain selection binding without inventing a web-only shell.
STU-WEB-030.planned_proof_cases: Resolve identical selection metadata from web and other-domain consumers; canonical owner receipt remains identical, future anchor relocation stays explicit debt.

STU-WEB-031.method: Select contextual panels from current selection; allow layout presets to change placement/prominence only, never applicability.
STU-WEB-031.planned_proof_cases: Keep selection fixed while changing layout preset and inspect same primary/secondary panels; changing selection recomputes binding without persona switch.

STU-WEB-032.method: Register declarative panel binding records through canonical shared panel registry and evaluate against selection; no mode/layer switch selects a panel.
STU-WEB-032.planned_proof_cases: Load different binding order and selection kinds; inspect same results from declarative matching, including no-match fallback.

STU-WEB-033.method: Decode nine panel fields with optional discriminator/context/render flags and required stable author namespace; validate document type eligibility.
STU-WEB-033.planned_proof_cases: Serialize complete and minimal records; missing required field or colliding namespace reports registration error before selection.

STU-WEB-034.method: Parse only literal, pipe alternation, wildcard, locked, comment and namespaced selector forms; reject regex/script predicates; apply document case rules.
STU-WEB-034.planned_proof_cases: Exercise six selector forms and alternations against HTML/XML selection; illegal expression fails registration without executable predicate evaluation.

STU-WEB-035.method: Compute exact, within and inside_locked relation against selected node/ancestry; expose scope rank without UI dependence.
STU-WEB-035.planned_proof_cases: Select node, descendant and locked descendant; verify applicable scopes and inside_locked-before-exact-before-within ordering at equal priority.

STU-WEB-036.method: Represent priority as integer with declared bands1/5/6/10/50; sort ascending, and preserve band6-versus5 refinement conflict pending spec decision.
STU-WEB-036.planned_proof_cases: Exercise each band plus invalid sixth-band registration; ascending result is visible and conflicting refinement expectation is reported, never silently inverted.

STU-WEB-037.method: Match discriminator field/value after declarative eligibility; report generic/refinement ordering defects at registration.
STU-WEB-037.planned_proof_cases: Register meta and viewport-meta siblings and inspect defect/result; retain lower-wins versus6-over5 contradiction as unresolved, no guessed priority algorithm.

STU-WEB-038.method: Gate panel eligibility on server_model/document_mode/capability/feature_flag closed keys; unmet requirement removes candidate instead of rendering disabled.
STU-WEB-038.planned_proof_cases: Change each context value and revoke capability; inspect candidate exclusion and unchanged source, then restore context and recompute.

STU-WEB-039.method: Translate five render flags into shared Controls presentation/read-only descriptors; keep flags out of resolution sort/filter.
STU-WEB-039.planned_proof_cases: Toggle each flag with same selection and verify same chosen panels; live-view readonly setter rejects write without changing eligibility.

STU-WEB-040.method: Filter eligible bindings, sort priority/scope/discriminator/panel_id, select primary, retain different-band secondaries and suppress same-band peers.
STU-WEB-040.planned_proof_cases: Permute registration/iteration order and inspect identical ordered receipt; tie cases cover locked/exact/within, discriminator and lexical ID.

STU-WEB-041.method: Emit receipt containing selection identity, full candidate reasons/ranks, primary, ordered secondaries and suppressed reasons through command port.
STU-WEB-041.planned_proof_cases: Query why panel appears without screenshot; compare receipt to resolution result and ensure suppressed peers stay inspectable but not authoritative.

STU-WEB-042.method: Analyze binding equivalence, discriminator ordering, unknown tags/kinds and author namespace collisions when registry loads.
STU-WEB-042.planned_proof_cases: Load each defect independently and together; diagnostics arrive before selection, valid registry loads without heuristic script matching.

STU-WEB-043.method: Publish binding/resolution state and ordered control descriptors with stable author IDs, kind/value/domain/enabled flag and typed setter via shared command/Argus ports.
STU-WEB-043.planned_proof_cases: Read and set each control headlessly using stable namespace; disabled or invalid-domain setter reports denial and retains prior value.

STU-WEB-044.method: Declare can_claim/initialize_ui/inspect/apply hook boundary; evaluate refinement after matching, initialize once, inspect current selection and apply via StudioCommand.
STU-WEB-044.planned_proof_cases: Exercise inspect/apply without direct authority mutation and ensure can_claim cannot replace declarative eligibility; optional-versus-required hook contradiction remains explicit blocker.

STU-WEB-045.method: Decode colouring scheme identity/applicability/priority/case/tag flags, keyword lists, delimiters, embedded delimiters, tag specs and sample text.
STU-WEB-045.planned_proof_cases: Load whole-document and embedded-only schemes, round-trip every field and reject malformed delimiter records with source location.

STU-WEB-046.method: Resolve overlapping language regions using declared scheme priorities and retain winner per byte range for command inspection.
STU-WEB-046.planned_proof_cases: Overlap fallback/wrapper/comment/embedded/top-level regions and inspect winners; equal-priority ambiguity is surfaced rather than guessed from iteration order.

STU-WEB-047.method: Scan exact declared opening/closing delimiter pairs into revision-bound embedded ranges and route colouring/hints/validation/comments to owning scheme.
STU-WEB-047.planned_proof_cases: Edit delimiters and compare boundaries for nested HTML/script regions; malformed or unmatched boundary reports diagnostic without regex guessing or source rewrite.

STU-WEB-048.method: Index keyword lists per declared scheme and tokenize bounded revision snapshots; exercise declared baseline scale without requiring own scheme count parity.
STU-WEB-048.planned_proof_cases: Load33 schemes/46 lists/6894 keywords and largest3522-keyword six-list scheme; measure typing/tokenization against approved existing budget, record unavailable vocabulary or budget as gap.

STU-WEB-049.method: Bind themes to stable token classes, resolve missing class through declared default and emit fallback diagnostic once per session.
STU-WEB-049.planned_proof_cases: Add unmapped language class and inspect same declared default across rendering/descriptor output; repeated tokens yield one diagnostic per session.

STU-WEB-050.method: Decode hint trigger/dismiss characters/whitespace/context/multivalue flags and ordered label/value/icon items; filter by actual cursor language.
STU-WEB-050.planned_proof_cases: Trigger and dismiss hints at region boundaries, whitespace and repeated values; incompatible language produces no hint and selecting item emits text edit.

STU-WEB-051.method: Load grouped hint items and optional descriptions, with built-in/CMS sources as referenced vocabulary; publish missing-description coverage in canonical manual descriptor.
STU-WEB-051.planned_proof_cases: Resolve descriptions for4811-item baseline and22 groups; group without docs stays usable and appears in UserManual coverage report.

STU-WEB-052.method: Load ten declarative validator sets and resolve by DTD/version; retain explicit tag/attribute/value/invalid/context/requirement tables, not count-based pass.
STU-WEB-052.planned_proof_cases: Select each table row and validate legal/illegal markup, reconcile availability against complete baseline table; absent rules or85/86 requirement distinction remain provenance gaps.

STU-WEB-053.method: Evaluate tag version applicability, value references, options, ancestor constraints, invalid combinations and at-least-one/exactly-one/all attribute groups.
STU-WEB-053.planned_proof_cases: Validate documents isolating each rule shape plus combined errors; output rule IDs/ranges without changing source and unknown reference reports load defect.

STU-WEB-054.method: Decode433 value-map keys with note/quote_rule/is_regex/type; compile regex only through bounded linear-time engine and reject unsupported patterns.
STU-WEB-054.planned_proof_cases: Exercise four quote rules, literal keys and adversarial regex input; unsupported/nonbounded pattern fails admission without partial validator state.

STU-WEB-055.method: Produce diagnostics with severity/rule_set_id/rule_id/byte_range/element_path/message/code and expose headless query bound to validated source revision.
STU-WEB-055.planned_proof_cases: Validate known-invalid and valid markup then read typed diagnostics via command surface; compare byte ranges to unchanged bytes and reject stale diagnostic revision.

STU-WEB-056.method: Load CSS/markup/script default records and resolve document override above site override above shipped values; represent unset limits distinctly from0.
STU-WEB-056.planned_proof_cases: Exercise enabled/disabled rules, maxerr50/indent4 and absent versuszero limit; retain markup list/count and unnamed library environment gaps before dispatch.

STU-WEB-057.method: Expose per-site language level3/5/6/current configuration with ecma_version/module/JSX and explicit opt-in rule overrides.
STU-WEB-057.planned_proof_cases: Import site and inspect constructor-super error plus other rules default-off; missing current-level or baseline library identity is reported, never guessed.

STU-WEB-058.method: Run linter over selection/document/site through shared batch port and return WEB055 diagnostics using language and rule IDs.
STU-WEB-058.planned_proof_cases: Lint all three scopes headlessly, cancel site batch and inspect completed diagnostics; preserve source and report canceled/incomplete result rather than clean-pass.

STU-WEB-059.method: Expose stable command descriptors for brace balance, parent selection, folding, indent/outdent, wrap and CSS code navigator; consume shared text editor mechanics.
STU-WEB-059.planned_proof_cases: Invoke each command by ID, inspect selection/fold/text or CSS-rule result, and undo mutating commands; unmatched braces or missing selection return typed outcome.

STU-WEB-060.method: Address stylesheet source, media query, selector and declaration nodes separately; create rule with one atomic command against named source/query.
STU-WEB-060.planned_proof_cases: Create same selector in two media queries and inspect correct target; unknown source/query or stale revision rejects without partial rule insertion.

STU-WEB-061.method: Publish exactly layout/text/border/background/more categories using shared Controls; more accepts any parser-valid property/value.
STU-WEB-061.planned_proof_cases: Inspect all five categories, author a valid noncurated property via more and retain it after reload; syntactically invalid input yields diagnostic without rewrite.

STU-WEB-062.method: Decode82 curated property records and924 ordered options with nonselectable separators, defaults, negative support and control types.
STU-WEB-062.planned_proof_cases: Reconcile full declared records against source assets, preserve option order and block divider selection; unavailable catalogue entries remain explicit data gap.

STU-WEB-063.method: Map14 declared CSS control kinds to shared Controls composition contracts, including repeated multivalue and per-side composites.
STU-WEB-063.planned_proof_cases: Inspect each kind inputs/value/events/headless setter and compose without copied widget mechanics; unsupported mapping is a named Controls dependency gap.

STU-WEB-064.method: Offer ordered15 length units, per-control eleven-unit restrictions and separate3 resolution units; store numeric magnitude and unit separately.
STU-WEB-064.planned_proof_cases: Switch allowed units on sizing/shadow/text controls and round-trip magnitude/unit; forbidden viewport unit on restricted control returns typed validation error.

STU-WEB-065.method: Load layout property control/default/negative/options from table and compose per-side edits as source patches; preserve unset versusauto/none.
STU-WEB-065.planned_proof_cases: Exercise widths/maxima/display/position/margin/padding/offsets and exact option order; reject prohibited negatives without silently clamping operator source.

STU-WEB-066.method: Keep opacity hard/soft min/max/default/unit/precision/step/coarse/fine values independently; shared range control uses explicit supplied values.
STU-WEB-066.planned_proof_cases: Drive0,1 and intermediate values with0.01/0.1/0.001 steps; invalid outside hard range is reported and soft bounds remain distinct serialized fields.

STU-WEB-067.method: Store magnitude/unit independently and retain per-field source-versus-studio_declared provenance; honor supports_negative_values and property-specific overrides.
STU-WEB-067.planned_proof_cases: Exercise positive-only width/padding/blur and negative margin/shadow offset; compare hard unknown provenance with explicit Studio declarations and never copy soft bounds into hard fields.

STU-WEB-068.method: Load text property controls/defaults/options exactly, bind profile-aware color/font stacks and compose ordered source edits.
STU-WEB-068.planned_proof_cases: Set keywords and numeric units for font/line-height/text-indent, list properties and text shadows; preserve undefined/unset defaults and field-specific unit restrictions.

STU-WEB-069.method: Compose border sides/corners and background multivalue fields using shared controls; retain each default, negative rule and ordered keyword domain.
STU-WEB-069.planned_proof_cases: Edit one side/corner and repeated backgrounds, round-trip source; invalid negative radius/spacing returns diagnostic and unrelated sides remain unchanged.

STU-WEB-070.method: Represent ordered shadow layers with box six-field or text four-field records; numeric components follow nonviewport length contract.
STU-WEB-070.planned_proof_cases: Add/reorder/remove layers and compare emitted order; text shadow rejects spread/inset and blur rejects negative, undo restores array/source.

STU-WEB-071.method: Index369 recognized names for assistance while parser-valid declarations remain authorable in more regardless of recognition.
STU-WEB-071.planned_proof_cases: Author unknown-but-valid property, retain source and inspect assistance fallback; malformed syntax receives diagnostic, not vocabulary-based rejection.

STU-WEB-072.method: Track emitted prefix triples against base declaration in same text transaction; remove exactly owned emitted prefixes on base removal.
STU-WEB-072.planned_proof_cases: Apply each declared value rule, then remove base and undo; hand-authored neighboring vendor declaration survives and base/prefix edits share one receipt.

STU-WEB-073.method: Expose ordered49 animatable properties,8 pseudo classes,6 timing functions and2 transition prefixes as declared vocabularies.
STU-WEB-073.planned_proof_cases: Author transitions using all lists and cubic-bezier parameters; invalid closed-list token yields diagnostic without generating a new implicit vocabulary.

STU-WEB-074.method: Consume shared StudioGradient stop model and declared saved-swatch capacity5; capacity increase requires declared manual choice.
STU-WEB-074.planned_proof_cases: Edit same gradient through web and shared gradient consumer, save/reload swatches at capacity; extra entry reports chosen policy without silently changing capacity.

STU-WEB-075.method: Pass SVG writer defaults trim/responsive true and precision1 with separate hard/soft bounds and source-declared provenance through existing export port.
STU-WEB-075.planned_proof_cases: Export same source with defaults and overridden integer precision; compare SVG bytes/profile/provenance, retain source-unknown hard maximum versus Studio10 declaration.

STU-WEB-076.method: Parse media query into optional media_type, ordered conditions and rules; each condition has feature/operator/value/unit fields.
STU-WEB-076.planned_proof_cases: Round-trip compound and typeless query preserving order; malformed feature/operator/value produces typed parse diagnostic without changing source.

STU-WEB-077.planned_proof_cases: Author and inspect each legal type plus invalid token; query preserves source and reports unsupported type rather than mapping it toscreen.

STU-WEB-078.method: Load23 media features with popup/number-unit/positive-ratio domains; reuse length/resolution vocabularies without fusing units into values.
STU-WEB-078.planned_proof_cases: Exercise orientation, dimensions/resolution and device/nondevice ratios; zero/negative ratio integer and wrong unit fail with preserved original query.

STU-WEB-079.method: Bind shared ruler geometry and drag conversion to exact13 shipped constants; distinguish content/handle width from authored query bounds.
STU-WEB-079.planned_proof_cases: Drive minimums/maximums/digits and border/pixel adjustments in hidden ruler consumer; inspect resulting query and controls at constrained width without altering declared constants.

STU-WEB-080.method: Store breakpoint hard7..5000/soft320..1920/current-viewport default, px, precision3/digits8 and1/10/0.001 steps independently.
STU-WEB-080.planned_proof_cases: Create at current viewport, edit hard edges and values outside soft range, inspect serialized fields; illegal precision/digits or hard-bound value reports validation.

STU-WEB-081.method: Decode min_width/max_width/min_and_max_width; range query stores two edges and requires span at least WEB079 min_range_value.
STU-WEB-081.planned_proof_cases: Create three kinds and compare emitted media text; too-small span fails without clamping either edge and undo restores valid query.

STU-WEB-082.method: Load framework descriptor version detection, breakpoint/prefix/class/offset/hide patterns, container/fluid/row classes and total_columns as ordered fields.
STU-WEB-082.planned_proof_cases: Detect pinned framework and map classes through descriptor; unmatched version returns unsupported/loss outcome, not guessed class rewriting.

STU-WEB-083.method: Loadv3/v4/v5 breakpoints, prefixes,widths,columns and bundle/style/script/helper references with exact family-specific class/offset/hide rules.
STU-WEB-083.planned_proof_cases: Render editable grid source for each family and compare class emission; missing bundle/helper is named capability gap and no server dependency is introduced.

STU-WEB-084.method: Represent columns1..24/soft6..12/default12 and gutter1..120/soft8..40/default30px as source-declared integer fields.
STU-WEB-084.planned_proof_cases: Exercise each hard edge and soft-exceeding value, serialize separately and reject out-of-hard range; preserve source-declared provenance.

STU-WEB-085.method: Keep exact framework/helper version pins on site; version switch computes explicit migration diff and receipt of every rewritten class.
STU-WEB-085.planned_proof_cases: Edit under pinned3.4.1/4.4.1/5.3.8 and migrate explicitly; unsupported helper/version or stale source rejects, receipt and undo preserve old classes.

STU-WEB-086.method: Resolve less/scss/sass source import graph through granted artifact ports and compile/source-map with site roots/style/policy via bounded batch port; publish only complete successful outputs.
STU-WEB-086.planned_proof_cases: Compile107-file import graph for each language, inspect mappings; syntax/import failure or cancel emits diagnostic and leaves previous stylesheet intact, provider absence is NOT_PROVEN.

STU-WEB-087.method: Expose preview viewport width and active media-query state via shared inspection/setter ports; jump-to-breakpoint changes width against current revision.
STU-WEB-087.planned_proof_cases: Set arbitrary width then jump each declared breakpoint headlessly; inspect active queries/render revision and report stale or unavailable preview without success claim.

STU-WEB-088.method: Consume design breakpoint IDs via design-system port and record one-to-one media-query mapping on generated document.
STU-WEB-088.planned_proof_cases: Generate mapped and unmapped breakpoint cases; inspect exact mapping and warning naming each unmapped design breakpoint without silently dropping it.

STU-WEB-089.method: Declare viewport-meta dedicated binding/discriminator with stated band6 and lint missing viewport as warning; consume shared contextual owner.
STU-WEB-089.planned_proof_cases: Select viewport meta versus generic meta and inspect binding receipt; missing declaration is warning, band6-versus5 contradiction remains unresolved before dispatch.

STU-WEB-090.method: Represent template type and editable-region declarations over StudioDocument; compose nested-template locks through ancestry and emit permitted instance edits as text patches.
STU-WEB-090.planned_proof_cases: Instantiate nested templates and edit allowed region, then attempt locked span; rejected edit preserves bytes and reload retains composed lock lineage.
